english.title: Knowingly send under 18 to obtain alcohol supplied by / on behalf of a club - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly sent an individual, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), who was under the age of 18, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AGE..), to obtain alcohol, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ALCOHOL..), supplied or to be supplied by or on behalf of a club, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CLUB AND LOCATION..), to or to the order of a member of that club for consumption off those premises
english.legislation: Contrary to section 152(1)(b) and (5) of the Licensing Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section152(4) provides that 152(1) also does not apply where the individual aged under 18 is sent by a constable, or a weights and measures inspector, who is acting in the course of his duty.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months
